_note: Canonical sponsor manifest for the SponsorRail component (js/sponsor-rail.js). Drives the commercial rail on every shareable graphic — Studio templates + public share cards. Allocation is CONTEXT-driven (home-kit / away-kit / neutral), never venue-driven: the caller passes the kit/content context and the rail returns the right partners in a FIXED order. Assets are pre-trimmed to visible artwork; sizing uses cap-height on the visible mark with optical correction <=10%. No King, Denham in the rail per the approved final list. Labels are Studio-only, never on public exports.
_historicalNote: SUPERSEDED (Aug 2026): this manifest previously read "No King, Denham in the rail per the approved final list" and contexts.home/away carried only ashwood + ahiq. The owner has since confirmed the current commercial requirement in writing — The King, Denham sits in the persistent rail alongside Ashwood and AHiQ on every post. Recorded rather than deleted so the change is traceable and nobody re-applies the old list from memory.
_railNote: PRESENTER vs RAIL. presents.home/away names the presenting sponsor, which the composition gives its own prominent position. The rail is the persistent partner strip and is deliberately secondary — Ashwood, The King Denham, AHiQ on every post, plus the kit supplier where the context includes it. The presenter also appears in contexts.home/away because the rail is what non-presenting layouts fall back to; a layout that gives the presenter a distinct slot should drop it from the rail rather than print it twice.
